def factor_tail_risk_intraday_overnight_abs_asymmetry(df):
    """Downside tail asymmetry using absolute overnight/intraday losses; negated share of intraday downside magnitude."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(
        df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"]
    )
    intra_down = np.minimum(intraday_ret, 0.0).abs()
    over_down = np.minimum(overnight_ret, 0.0).abs()
    intra_lpm = intra_down.rolling(60, min_periods=30).mean()
    over_lpm = over_down.rolling(60, min_periods=30).mean()
    total_lpm = intra_lpm + over_lpm
    intra_share = intra_lpm / total_lpm.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    factor = -intra_share
    return pd.Series(factor, index=df_copy.index, name="factor_tail_risk_intraday_overnight_abs_asymmetry")
description: Preserves the parent tail-risk mechanism of comparing intraday vs overnight downside fragility using the active decompose_overnight_intraday tool. The mutation replaces squared downside (variance-like) with absolute downside magnitude, reducing the influence of a few large gap days and improving cross-sectional rank stability. High intraday absolute loss share yields a negative signal; the factor remains raw single-stock and interpretable.
